articles.title: SK HYNIX PERPETUALS HIT BY FLASH CRASH TO $900 ON HYPERLIQUID
articles.summary: SK Hynix perpetual futures on Hyperliquid flash-crashed 20% to $900 on July 28 between 23:00 and 23:01 UTC, recovering above $1,000 within one minute, with analysts attributing the move to thin overnight liquidity that left the venue unable to absorb large orders at stable prices. The crash preceded SK Hynix shares falling 15% when the Korean Stock Exchange opened an hour later, alongside an 11% Kospi decline and losses at Samsung Electronics and Hyundai Motor, underscoring crypto perps acting as a price-discovery venue ahead of the underlying equity market. The equity selloff connects to a broader AI hardware correction: Nvidia fell 5% on reports of a $250 billion data-center commitment to an OpenAI-affiliated venture, dragging SK Hynix, a primary supplier of high-bandwidth memory chips for AI processors, to a cumulative decline of close to 48% from its June 26 peak.

articles.title: CRYPTO STEADIES AS IRAN-US PAUSE SENDS OIL TUMBLING
articles.summary: An Iran-US ceasefire over the Strait of Hormuz drove Brent crude down 7% to ~$87/barrel, easing inflation concerns and boosting risk appetite across asset classes. CME FedWatch pricing for a Fed rate hike this week fell from 37.4% to 30.5% following the de-escalation, with inflation running at 4.1% ahead of the decision. Bitcoin held flat at $65,200 while Ether gained 0.51% to $1,963, approaching the $2,000 level, and the CoinDesk 20 Index added 1.6% over 24 hours. DeFi tokens led the recovery: AAVE and LDO each gained around 9%, ONDO rose 7%, and PUMP surged 12.24% toward an $800 million market cap.

articles.title: BASE LAUNCHES BASE VERIFY ONCHAIN FOR SYBIL-RESISTANT AIRDROPS
articles.summary: Base Verify Onchain lets smart contracts enforce "one real person, one claim" by generating a deterministic identity hash tied to a verified Coinbase, Instagram, X, or TikTok account without exposing personal data to the contract, replacing the need for developers to run their own off-chain dedupe database. The underlying Base Verify system has been used over 300,000 times for partners including Base App and Bracket. Use cases include airdrops resistant to wallet-farming, per-person token sale caps, and one-person-one-vote governance.

articles.title: STRUSD: INSTITUTIONAL DELTA-NEUTRAL YIELD ON-CHAIN
articles.summary: Tori Finance's strUSD is a yield-bearing token backed by institutional delta-neutral strategies targeting 12% APY, with returns structured to be uncorrelated with crypto market direction. The strategies powering strUSD previously required eight-figure capital minimums, restricting them to large institutions. Onchain tokenization removes that floor entirely. The token deploys with day-one DeFi integrations, making strUSD available as a composable yield layer for protocols seeking low-correlation returns.

articles.title: VISA STABLECOIN PLATFORM EXPLAINER: WHY VISA LAUNCHED WITH OPEN USD
articles.summary: The new Visa Stablecoin Platform (VSP) lets banks and fintechs mint, burn, and manage stablecoins through a single Visa-run environment, launching with Open USD because banks trust bank-governed stablecoins over Circle or Tether. EY Parthenon found 63% of corporates want stablecoin access via their own bank. VSP supports Ethereum, Solana, and Tempo with maker/checker controls, passkey signing, and wallet-as-a-service, mirroring how Visa DPS lets thousands of issuers process debit without building their own infrastructure. Visa's approach of not picking winners will scale quickly since every participating bank becomes invested in the network's growth.

articles.title: THE RISE AND QUIET DEATH OF THE NEOBANK
articles.summary: A live audit of 368 verified-active neobanks serving a combined 1.46 billion users finds Asia holding 817 million of those customers, with WeBank alone at 400 million-plus and Nubank's 131 million Latin American users exceeding the entire US neobank base, while Revolut's 50 million European accounts are a footnote by comparison. Only 127 of the 368 hold a full banking license, leaving the majority dependent on sponsor banks and BaaS intermediaries whose failures routed customers into bankruptcy proceedings rather than deposit insurance, because the ledger tracking which dollars belonged to whom was the layer that broke. Among neobanks founded in the 2020s that remain active, 30% are web3-native self-custodial apps versus 4% of the 2010s cohort, and an audit of AI claims found only 67 of 368 companies (18%) with verified production deployments, led not by Western incumbents but by thin-file lenders in Nigeria, the Philippines, and Mexico where model-based underwriting is the prerequisite for the business to exist at all. Machine-to-machine banking rails for AI agents is a seven-company niche today that structurally resembles where web3-native finance sat in 2021.

articles.title: WHEN DO STABLECOINS BECOME A REAL MONETARY SYSTEM?
articles.summary: Stablecoins only become a true monetary system once they're used on the liability side of the economy. This means paying suppliers, wages, and taxes, and that high matching between stablecoin receivables and payables lets economic activity run without constantly converting back to bank deposits. Stablecoins don't eliminate banking but relocate it, becoming a private monetary base on top of which a new form of banking will be rebuilt to supply credit and elasticity.

articles.title: BITMINE NEARS GOAL OF CONTROLLING 5% OF ETHEREUM SUPPLY
articles.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies now holds 5.79 million ETH (approximately 4.8% of circulating supply), valued at roughly $11.3 billion, closing in on its 5% concentration target with weekly purchases that accelerated to 9,946 ETH last week from 7,430 the prior week. Approximately 85% of holdings (4.9 million ETH) are staked through its MAVAN validator network, projecting $299 million in annualized staking rewards once the full position is deployed. Total assets reach $11.8 billion across ETH, 208 BTC, $268 million in cash and securities, and strategic equity stakes in Beast Industries and Eightco Holdings, making Bitmine the largest corporate Ether treasury among public companies. The ETH/BTC ratio hit a 3-month high of 0.3000 last week as ETH gained approximately 2.4% against Bitcoin's 0.7% decline, coinciding with Bitmine repurchasing 11.6 million common shares since July 1 under a $4 billion buyback program.

articles.title: ROBINHOOD CHAIN SHOWS FASTEST MONEY VELOCITY AMONG MAJOR CHAINS
articles.summary: Robinhood Chain turns over 1.66x its TVL in daily DEX volume on a 30-day average, versus 0.21x for Base, 0.17x for Solana, and 0.03x for Ethereum.

articles.title: STRIPE HIRING A PRODUCT LEAD FOR ITS LINK WALLET
articles.summary: Stripe is hiring a product manager to build out Link, its consumer money-and-identity wallet spanning mobile, web, and API.

articles.title: TOKENIZED EQUITY TRADING IS SHIFTING TO RFQ EXCHANGES
articles.summary: RFQ now accounts for 75% of tokenized-equity trading volume, up from earlier dominance by concentrated-liquidity AMMs and a PropAMM phase that briefly hit 50%, because equities are still priced by the underlying stock market and RFQ makers can hedge instantly against real shares without pre-funding pools for every stock-USDC pair.

articles.title: KYLE SAMANI AND MULTICOIN CAPITAL'S PUBLIC FALLING-OUT
articles.summary: Kyle Samani's departure from Multicoin Capital has become a public falling-out, with both parties trading barbs over a hard thesis split.
